queries_run: Micron largest customer second source OR in-house memory 2026
Nvidia HBM second source Samsung SK Hynix Micron 2026
Micron single-source risk customer diversify supplier concentration
Apple Samsung custom memory chip in-house insourcing DRAM 2026

findings.claim: Micron signed 16 strategic long-term supply agreements with data center, consumer, and automotive customers, most take-or-pay and running from CY2026 through late 2030; 14 of the first 16 total roughly $100B in combined minimum contracted revenue, locking customers into Micron rather than customers qualifying alternate/in-house sources.
findings.source: The Motley Fool, "Micron's Customers Are Putting Up $22 Billion, and Its CEO Says Data Centers Want 50% More Memory Than It Can Ship", https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/24/micron-s-customers-are-putting-up-usd22-billion-and-its-ceo-says-data-centers-want-50-more-memory-than-it-can-ship/

findings.claim: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang confirmed on 2026-06-05 that Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron have all passed certification to supply HBM4 for Nvidia's Vera Rubin platform; supply-chain analysts estimate SK Hynix holds roughly 60-70% of Vera Rubin HBM4 volume, Samsung ~25-30%, and Micron the remainder — i.e. Micron's largest AI customer already multi-sources HBM across three qualified suppliers, with Micron as the smallest share.
findings.source: Yahoo Finance, "Nvidia certifies Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron for Vera Rubin HBM4 supply"; TweakTown, "SK hynix, Samsung, and Micron fighting for NVIDIA supply contracts for new 16-Hi HBM4 orders", https://finance.yahoo.com/sectors/technology/articles/nvidia-certifies-samsung-sk-hynix-133001560.html

note: Apple/Samsung mobile-DRAM search returned only Apple-Samsung/SK Hynix supplier dynamics with no mention of Micron as an Apple supplier, so not used as a Micron-specific finding. Historical customer-concentration disclosures (Intel 14% in 2016, Kingston 2014-2015) found via SEC filings are stale (pre-2020) and excluded as not current.
